from scipy.optimize import least_squares
S=np.sign(v)*np.abs(v)**0.5
def run(name,fn,q0s):
    best=None
    for q0 in q0s:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: fn(q)-dv_dt,np.array(q0,float),max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dv_dt), np.round(best.x,4))
run('exp', lambda q: q[0]+q[1]*S+q[2]*x+q[3]*np.exp(-q[4]*t), [[3,-4,0,8,0.3],[3,-4,0,8,0.1],[3,-4,0,5,0.6]])
run('exp+cos', lambda q: q[0]+q[1]*S+q[2]*x+q[3]*np.exp(-q[4]*t)+q[5]*np.cos(q[6]*t)+q[7]*np.sin(q[6]*t), [[3,-4,0,8,0.3,1,0.344,0.5],[3,-4,0,8,0.1,1,1.0,1]])
run('pow', lambda q: q[0]+q[1]*S+q[2]*x+q[3]*t**q[4], [[3,-4,0,8,-0.5],[3,-4,0,8,-1.0]])
